entities.label: LAWYER

sentences.text: List of fresh cases has been revised.
No one is appeared on behalf of the applicants.
However, Sri Kamlesh Kumar Tripathi, learned AGA for the State is present.

2. Present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed for quashing the entire proceedings as well as summoning order dated 29.05.2024 passed in Complaint Case No.106683 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Kotwali, District Varanasi.
3. From perusal of order sheet, it appears that this matter was taken up on 03.10.2024.

On that day,
counsel for the applicant was not present, therefore, the matter was adjourned.
Today again no one is appeared on behalf of the applicants.
4. Therefore, the present application is dismissed for want of prosecution.

Order Date :- 4.12.2024 A.Kr.
